theses.subject: US Energy Complex
theses.thesis: Energy Complex pairs a high momentum score (1.375, rank 2) with the broadest participation among leaders (breadth 0.636) and above-median durability (0.62), and it is trend-gate eligible (no extended drawdown regime). Unlike the AI Infrastructure leader, the trend proof is distributed across the complex rather than concentrated, which is the staying-power leg that matters when momentum itself has no forward edge.
evidence: score 1.375, rank 2 and within a thin margin (0.185) of the leader
hurst_tag 'mixed' but above the 0.5 durability bar, crowding_z 0.93 below the crowded flag
theses.dissent: Energy is a cyclical, oil-price-sensitive complex and the leader AI Infrastructure could re-absorb all attention if a single AI capex catalyst hits; energy leadership this cycle has repeatedly failed to sustain beyond a few weeks.

falsifier.text: XLE is flat or negative over the next 30 trading days while SMH is up mid-single-digits or more

theses.subject: Managed Care & Insurers
theses.thesis: This is the most durable and broad theme in the entire eligible set (durability_bar 0.81, breadth 0.778) despite a slightly negative score (-0.08). The detector's only validated edge is drawdown/shake-out avoidance, and this theme's trend coherence is the strongest 'staying-power' signal available, even though momentum/attention is not behind it.
evidence: eligible: true, durability_bar 0.81 (highest in the eligible set)
crowded: true (crowding_z 1.11) — a sizing caution, not a fade
theses.dissent: The score is negative and attention/flow is absent; crowding_z above 1 flags it as a popular defensive trade, which historically marks near-term underperformance even when the trend is healthy.

falsifier.text: XLV (or the managed-care constituent group) breaks below its 50-day average and stays there for two consecutive weeks before the check-by date

theses.subject: AI Infrastructure
theses.thesis: The leader is trend-gate eligible and not crowded, so this is not a fade, but the leadership proof is thin: breadth 0.125 (few names carrying the move), Hurst 'mixed', and a 10-day return already negative (-0.0916). With rank-IC ~0, leaning fresh capital into a narrow, mixed-trend leader on the basis of rank alone is not justified; the thesis is to avoid new overweight here pending confirmation of breadth repair.
evidence: crowded: false — no crowding caution, but also no breadth confirmation
theses.dissent: AI Infrastructure is the dominant narrative with the highest score and a standing macro headline tailwind ('ai_tech' in dominant themes); avoiding it risks underperforming if the AI capex cycle re-accelerates.

falsifier.text: SMH breadth recovers above 0.5 and its Hurst tag flips to 'trend' before the check-by date

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
